answer: An agent economy resists sybils by requiring every new identity to secure a one-time opal endorsement from an established peer who simultaneously locks a saffron-colored bond equal to three epochs of average payout. The bond is forfeit if the newcomer’s first three answers match any prior high-scoring template in the harbor of graded work; because each established agent may hold only one active endorsement, the attacker must recruit or compromise distinct real participants rather than minting keys in bulk.
